executedLateAck:
local q=_G.CloudBackendQA;assert(q.phase=="reloaded")
q.phase="late-ack"
task.spawn(function()
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local p=q.profiles.User_100
  p.coins=350;p.revision+=1;p.stageScore=10;p.runEarnings=20
  assert(q.b:saveProfile("User_100",p),"controlled QA funding failed")
  local Profile=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GrabIt.Shared.Profile)
  local before=Profile.capture(p)
  q.dropNextAcknowledgement=true
  local status=q.b:purchase("User_100","field",before,"late_"..q.runId)
  assert(status=="pending","withheld commit acknowledgement must remain pending")
  local committed=q.store:GetAsync(q.prefix.."User_100",q.options)
  assert(committed.coins==0 and committed.owned.field,"cloud purchase did not actually commit")
  p.coins+=20;p.revision+=1;p.stageScore+=20;p.runEarnings+=20
  local retry,confirmed=q.b:purchase("User_100","field",before,"late_"..q.runId)
  assert(retry=="confirmed" and confirmed.coins==0,"retry did not confirm one debit")
  assert(Profile.confirmPurchase(p,before,confirmed),"concurrent change must request another save")
  assert(p.coins==20 and p.owned.field and p.selected=="canvas" and p.stageScore==30 and p.runEarnings==40,"merge lost synthetic concurrent change")
  assert(q.b:saveProfile("User_100",p),"merged state save failed")
  assert(not q.b:saveProfile("User_100",before),"old snapshot restored spent funds")
  assert(q.b:releaseProfile("User_100",p),"late-ack lease release failed")
  local recovered=q.c:load("User_100")
  assert(recovered and recovered.coins==20 and recovered.owned.canvas and recovered.owned.field and recovered.selected=="canvas","new owner lost merged state")
  assert(recovered.stageScore==nil and recovered.runEarnings==nil,"transient scores leaked into cloud profile")
  assert(q.c:releaseProfile("User_100",recovered),"replacement owner release failed")
  for _,key in {"User_350","User_900"}do assert(q.b:releaseProfile(key,q.profiles[key]),"other QA lease release failed")end
  q.lateAck={pendingAfterCommit=true,committedCoins=0,retryConfirmedOneDebit=true,syntheticConcurrentCoins=20,restoredCoins=recovered.coins,selected=recovered.selected,oldSnapshotRejected=true,locksReleased=true}
 end)
 q.phase=if ok then "verified" else "failed";q.error=not ok and tostring(err)or nil
end)
return {phase=q.phase}

 local all=true
 for _,suffix in {"User_100","User_350","User_900"}do
  local key=q.prefix..suffix;local done=false;local last=nil;local attempts=0

 end

 q.phase=if all then "cleaned" else "cleanup-failed"
end)
